scope: CSV export group option, account energy-unit default, preparation status and cancellation
approach: Restore the source panel behavior through the existing authenticated JSON export API. The source file is a reference, not a byte-for-byte copy. Account energy-unit default is resolved once by the server export adapter.

coverage: Grouped kJ download through production HTTP handler
Cancel aborts pending download; close/reopen disposes the old request
No browser/CSP errors or horizontal overflow
